Business domain map

What Bunkai is for, how it earns, and what every domain term means. Source of truth: the target repo ../upex-bunkai-tms at origin/staging (98ee1b4, 2026-10-11). Every path below is relative to that repo unless it starts with .context/ of this QA repo.

Overview

Confidence: Medium. Product mechanics (data model, roles, tiers, execution modes, Jira import, billing checkout) are read straight from migrations and routes. Customer segments, channels and support model have no code footprint and come only from the product's own pre-code vision document, so they stay unconfirmed.

Problem statement

Bunkai is a Test Management System (TMS), described on its public About page as "Test Management System open core para equipos de QA" (app/about/page.tsx). Its pitch: test management tools store documents but do not teach how to test (app/about/page.tsx). The page names four pains (app/about/_components/sections.tsx, PainSolution()): the same manual step duplicated across dozens of test cases with no single edit point; no way to know which tests are still valid as the product changes; Story to AC to test traceability scattered across spreadsheets and memory; and bugs handed to an external tracker the moment they fail, losing which ATC failed and under what run.

The structural answer is to put the discipline into the data model: "un ATC sin historia de usuario no puede existir". The schema enforces it: an ATC must bind to at least one Acceptance Criterion of its own User Story (supabase/migrations/0021_atc_create_update.sql, SQLSTATE 45020).

Bunkai is the productization of the KATA test architecture and the IQL methodology this QA repo itself uses (sections.tsx, Origin()). The Jira ticket id is the literal join key between a KATA @atc('BK-xxx') method and a Bunkai ATC. See KATA to Bunkai mapping.

Target users

QA teams working inside a multi-tenant Workspace with four roles the database enforces: owner, admin, member, viewer (0001_tenancy.sql). AI agents and CI pipelines are first-class users through Personal Access Tokens (lib/api/pat.ts).

Value proposition (what ships today)

  • One ATC, many Tests: an ATC edit propagates to every Test that chains it (0035_atc_update_propagation.sql).
  • Traceability enforced by schema: User Story, AC, ATC, Test, Run, Bug (0068_story_traceability_report.sql).
  • Manual, agent and CI runs share one Run type against the same ATCs (0031_runs.sql).
  • Native bugs anchored to module, ATC and run step, with a one-way sync to an external tracker (0046_bugs.sql).
  • API-first: an agent with a PAT drives the same REST API a human uses (app/api/v1/).
  • Jira import by JQL brings existing stories and ACs in (lib/jira/import-runner.ts).
  • Test Plans group Tests for a goal or release (0073_test_plans.sql, 0076_test_plan_tests.sql).
  • Paid upgrade to the Cloud tier through Stripe Checkout (0077_billing_upgrade_checkout.sql).

The About page capability matrix (Capabilities.tsx) still marks "Test plans y milestones" and "Asientos, tiers y facturas" as próximo although both now have shipped schema and routes. The matrix lags the code; see discovery gaps.

QA relevance

Business aspectTesting implication
RLS is the only tenant-isolation boundaryEvery new table or RPC needs an "other workspace cannot see or change this" negative test; the target repo already uses *-isolation.test.ts for this.
Four roles gate mutations differently per resourceCover a role matrix, not just signed-in vs anonymous; negative tests for every role below the threshold.
Billing upgrade goes through Stripe hosted checkout and a webhookTest the checkout session guard (one open session per workspace), webhook idempotency (event-id dedupe) and the plan change; never against live Stripe charges.
Jira import, workspace export and the run sweep are asynchronousDesign for polling and eventual consistency, partial failure and idempotent re-runs, not plain request/response.
ATC edit propagation is the core promiseTreat propagation correctness as P0 regression surface.
Workspace deletion is a 30-day soft deleteEvery entity of a deleted workspace must become unreachable immediately (BK-991, BK-988 history).

ATC (Acceptance Test Case)

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTableFound in
ATCAtcATCatcs0004_atcs.sql, lib/types.ts
ATC StepAtcStepStepatc_steps0004_atcs.sql
ATC AssertionAtcAssertionAssertionatc_assertions0004_atcs.sql

Business meaning: the reusable atomic unit of verification: ordered steps (content, optional input data, expected result) plus assertions, bound to at least one AC of its own User Story. One ATC is chained by many Tests; editing it updates them all. Carries a layer, an execution status, up to 10 tags, a version, and two optional classifications shipped by BK-399: test-design technique and ATC priority. Unset classifications stay NULL and display "not specified".

Rules: no orphan ATCs (empty or foreign AC set rejected, SQLSTATE 45020); tag cap 10 (SQLSTATE 45024).

Related terms: Test, Run, Acceptance Criterion.

Abbreviations: ATC = Acceptance Test Case. Never "Atomic Test Component" (banned by the product glossary, see anti-glossary).

Run

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTableFound in
RunRunRunruns0031_runs.sql
Run ATC (position)RunAtc(chain position in the Runner)run_atcs0031_runs.sql
Run StepRunStepStep verdictrun_steps0031_runs.sql, 0042_run_step_mark.sql

Business meaning: one execution of a Test against a Project Environment, by a human, an agent or CI. Each chain position is snapshotted (run_atcs.atc_title) so later ATC edits never rewrite history. Status has two stored grains: run grain (running, passed, failed, aborted) and position/step grain (pending, passed, failed, blocked, skipped). aborted exists only at run grain.

Automatic behaviour: a pg_cron sweep aborts idle running Runs with a system-generated reason (BK-269, 0075_run_inactivity_sweep.sql).

Related terms: Test, Bug, Project Environment.

Bug

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTableFound in
BugBugBugbugs0046_bugs.sql

Business meaning: a native defect record anchored to a Module and optionally to the ATC, Run and Run Step it failed on. Has a Severity (P1-P4, shown Critical/Major/Minor/Trivial), a forward-only Status (open to in_progress to resolved to closed, one step at a time, SQLSTATE 45310/45311), up to 10 evidence links, and an assignee who must be an active non-viewer member (45312/45313). "Not found" and "not a member" return the same 404.

Related terms: Run, Module.

Note: a Bunkai Bug is a product entity, not this QA repo's Jira Bug/Defect classification.

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTableFound in
Test Plantest_plansTest plantest_plans0073_test_plans.sql
Test Plan membershiptest_plan_tests(tests in the plan)test_plan_tests0076_test_plan_tests.sql

Business meaning: a named grouping of Tests inside a Project for a goal, cycle or release (BK-202, BK-203). Name 1-100 characters (whitespace normalized, case-insensitive unique), goal up to 100, description up to 500, status open or closed. Membership is a reference, never a copy: a Test can sit in many plans, at most once per plan, and removing it never touches the Test.

Not the ATP. The ATP is this QA repo's per-story test plan artifact; a Test Plan is the product's grouping entity. Never say bare "plan".

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTableFound in

Business meaning: the workspace subscription level: community, cloud, enterprise. Seat and project usage meters show normal, warning (80% and up, inclusive) or limit-reached (100% and up); unlimited never warns. Upgrade to cloud opens a Stripe hosted Checkout Session (one open session per workspace; statuses open, completed, expired, canceled); the webhook, deduplicated by Stripe event id, sets the plan and purchased_seats. Invoices are not built.

Never "Free / Team / Enterprise", never bare "plan".

Workspace Deletion

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTableFound in
Workspace Deletionworkspaces.deleted_atDelete workspaceworkspaces0084_workspace_deletion.sql
Deletion tombstoneworkspace_deletions(none)workspace_deletions0084_workspace_deletion.sql

Business meaning: owner-only soft delete with a 30-day grace period (BK-512, product ADR-0015). Access is revoked immediately for everyone, the owner included; the owner can restore during grace (deleted_at = null, no data movement); a pg_cron job purges after the deadline. An audit tombstone outside the cascade survives the purge. SQLSTATE 45900 owner only, 45901 already deleted, 45902 not deleted. Migration 0089 made workspace helper functions ignore deleted workspaces (BK-991 fix).

Related terms: Workspace.

Structure: pending, business-data-context is still a placeholder.

Workspace Data Export

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTableFound in
Workspace Data Exportworkspace_exportsRequest an exportworkspace_exports0083_workspace_data_export.sql

Business meaning: an owner-only, cookie-session-only (never PAT) archive of the workspace's data (BK-508). One export in flight per workspace; lifecycle queued, running, completed, failed, like Import Job; built by a Vercel after() worker into Supabase Storage; downloadable for 7 days. Every download re-checks owner, ready and unexpired, and writes an export.downloaded activity row.

Not the per-project ATC export (app/api/v1/projects/[id]/atcs/export/route.ts) or the traceability snapshot export.

Discovery gaps

  • Customer Segments, Channels, Customer Relationships, Cost Structure: no code footprint; only the target repo's pre-code vision doc. Needs a human to confirm current go-to-market.
  • Capability matrix lag: app/about/_components/Capabilities.tsx marks Test Plans, billing and the notification inbox/preferences as próximo, yet schema and routes exist (0073, 0076, 0077, 0053, 0062). Not verified which of these are wired in the UI on staging.
  • Stripe mode on staging (test vs live keys) not verified; the webhook and checkout routes exist.
  • Invoices (BK-231) not built; no subscription table beyond checkout-session ids.
  • Milestone to Test Plan aggregation (BK-206) not built.
  • Post-MVP entities named in the product glossary with no table yet: Channel, Message, Mention, Rich Link, Invoice, CI Results File.
  • Reserved suite tags (smoke, sanity, regression) verified from the product glossary only, not from a code constant.
  • lib/types/supabase.ts collapses CHECK columns to string; enumerations were read from migrations, so a later migration that alters a CHECK must be re-read.
  • Structure pointers: every term's attributes, relationships and lifecycle belong to business-data-context, still a placeholder. Fill the Structure lines after project-context mode data.
  • Local checkout of ../upex-bunkai-tms sits on an older commit than origin/staging; this map was built from origin/staging.
